decisions.reason: The automatic product-type field handling is explicitly limited to TikTok and does not change the Shopify listing process.
Automatic population of a TikTok listing field does not change which products the tracking spreadsheet records or how they are recorded.
The TikTok product-type field behavior does not affect product sourcing or the evidence used to select CJ Dropshipping products.
The content bank is unrelated to TikTok Shop product-listing field population.
The source concerns a TikTok Shop catalog field, not daily social-post scheduling or publishing.
